subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as optional `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool, and should this older broad PR or the newer narrower https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102243 be the landing branch?
rationale: The source evidence supports a first-class append primitive, but the permanent model-facing tool contract and duplicate landing-branch choice are maintainer-owned product/API decisions.

options.title: Accept append flag and pick one branch
options.body: Approve `append?: boolean` as the smallest default-preserving API and land one candidate after exact-head validation, closing the other as duplicate afterward.

options.title: Request a different append API
options.body: Ask contributors to reshape the implementation around a string `mode` or a separate append tool before either candidate lands.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open but defer landing if maintainers want broader file-locking, backup, or workspace-protection design first.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag and pick one branch
recommendation.body: Approve `append?: boolean` as the smallest default-preserving API and land one candidate after exact-head validation, closing the other as duplicate afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history-backed owner for the agent tool contract and product/API boundary decision.
